extensions.scope: Expanded global collection and desktop note-paper extension; inherits Soft Paper Play elsewhere.

components.name: Ticket card
components.description: Smooth-sided context card with a broader bottom-right curve and note-derived tonal wash. Solid padded Supericons sit in light note-derived circles; Open and Return remain separate. Inline sample icon is documentation only.
components.css: .ds-ticket { position:relative; width:210px; height:228px; border-radius:20px 20px 44px 20px; color:var(--note-foreground,#171b18); background:linear-gradient(145deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--note-paper,#f9df5b) 92%,white),var(--note-paper,#f9df5b) 65%); mask:none; } .ds-ticket-read { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; padding:18px; text-align:left; border:0; border-radius:inherit; color:inherit; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-ticket-read strong { display:block; font:700 21px/1.2 var(--font-display,Manrope,sans-serif); letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-ticket-read span { display:block; margin-top:10px; font:500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); } .ds-ticket-read svg { position:absolute; left:18px; bottom:20px; width:24px; height:24px; padding:12px; box-sizing:content-box; border-radius:50%; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--note-paper,#f9df5b) 25%,white); color:#424242; } .ds-ticket-read em { position:absolute; right:79px; bottom:25px; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 8px; font:600 11px/1.1 var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); } .ds-ticket-read:focus-visible { outline:3px solid currentColor; outline-offset:-5px; } .ds-ticket-return { position:absolute; right:14px; bottom:17px; width:62px; height:38px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:600 11px/1 var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-ticket-return:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 12%,transparent); } .ds-ticket-return:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:-2px; } .ds-ticket::after { content:""; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:0; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:36px 0 0 0; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--note-paper,#f9df5b) 90%,var(--note-foreground,#171b18)); pointer-events:none; }

components.name: Done
components.description: Flush and hide the contextual note; inherits its paired paper and foreground.
components.css: .ds-done { height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid rgb(38 41 35 / 14%); border-radius:999px; background:var(--note-foreground,#171b18); color:var(--note-paper,#f9df5b); font:700 12px/1 var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 140ms ease; } .ds-done:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-done:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-done:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--olive,#536a4f); outline-offset:2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-done { transition:none; } }

components.name: Collection search
components.description: Pale rounded search field on the scoped light frosted material.
components.css: .ds-search { display:block; width:250px; min-height:38px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; background:rgb(255 253 247 / 80%); color:#4f574c; } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-height:38px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#262923; font:400 14px var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:#52594e; opacity:1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline:2px solid #4b643d; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:none; }

components.name: Application filters
components.description: Solid soft-charcoal application marks, visible app names and inline counts. Note-derived pale fills, keyboard focus and horizontal scrolling at narrow widths.
components.css: .ds-filters { display:flex; gap:8px; overflow-x:auto; padding:4px 0; background:#f8f7f2; } .ds-filters button { flex:0 0 auto; height:38px; padding:8px 12px; border:0; border-radius:12px; color:#424242; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--note-paper,#e7ddb6) 14%,#f8f7f2); font:500 13px var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true] { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--note-paper,#e7ddb6) 35%,#f8f7f2); } .ds-filters button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4b643d; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Palette swatch
components.description: Named paper choice with a paired foreground and selected indicator.
components.css: .ds-swatch { width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; border:1px solid rgb(38 41 35 / 18%); border-radius:50%; background:var(--note-paper,#f9df5b); color:var(--note-foreground,#171b18); cursor:pointer; } .ds-swatch:hover { outline:1px solid currentColor; outline-offset:1px; } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--olive,#536a4f); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Note application pill
components.description: 48px light colourful application pill with a padded 24px soft #424242 solid Supericons mark. Pick light shared-palette accents (luminance >=0.45), excluding the note colour, similar hues and the prior pill. All 32 note papers have multiple options; dark icon/paired ink contrast >=4.5:1. Thin ink outline distinguishes light-on-light surfaces. Random on opening or paper change, stable while writing. Known-app Supericons precede Windows logos. Inline placeholder is documentation only.
components.css: .ds-app-pill { display:grid; place-items:center; width:48px; height:48px; padding:12px; box-sizing:border-box; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--context-pill-ink,#171b18) 35%,var(--context-pill-paper,#ffb792)); border-radius:999px; background:var(--context-pill-paper,#ffb792); color:var(--context-pill-ink,#171b18); } .ds-app-pill svg { width:24px; height:24px; }

components.name: Type / Draw
components.description: Inherited quiet editing-mode pill, with interface typography.
components.css: .ds-modes { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:2px; border:1px solid rgb(38 41 35 / 12%); border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper,#fffdf7) 68%,transparent); } .ds-modes button { min-width:54px; min-height:24px; padding:0 9px; border:0; border-radius:999px; color:#262923; background:transparent; font:600 11px/1 var(--font-ui,"DM Sans",sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-modes button[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--paper,#fffdf7); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgb(38 41 35 / 8%); } .ds-modes button:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper,#fffdf7) 86%,transparent); } .ds-modes button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--olive,#536a4f); outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview:
Soft Paper Play remains the incumbent product identity: warm paper, dark ink, quiet functional chrome and handwriting inside the note. The owner-selected ticket collection extends that world with stronger paper colours, smooth-sided cards with a bottom-right curve and a light frosted collection surface. It does not replace the light Home, library or contextual editing identity.

This snapshot records source implementation on 11 October 2026. Palette selections are durable across desktop note surfaces; curved geometry and light material apply only to the expanded global collection. Browser evidence uses synthetic notes. Installed Windows acceptance and publication remain open.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile note paper with explicit paired foregrounds.
Crisp functional type; Kalam remains note content.
Note-derived tonal cards inside the scoped light collection; soft elevation for the editor.
Application identity and captured context stay separate.

rules.name: The Paired Paper Rule
rules.body: A `note-<id>` paper always uses the matching `ink-<id>` foreground. Palette-pair contrast checks require at least 4.5:1; they do not establish contrast for every mixed hover, popover or logo treatment.

rules.name: The Functional Type Rule
rules.body: Use interface type for actions and context identity; reserve Kalam for note content and existing handwritten accents.

rules.name: The Scoped Material Rule
rules.body: Dark frosted material belongs to the expanded global collection. Preserve warm paper and soft elevation elsewhere unless separately approved.

dos: Do inherit Soft Paper Play outside the scoped collection.
Do apply each note paper together with its paired foreground.
Do keep 32 picker choices while preserving the original eight persisted IDs and eight-colour creation rotation.
Do use captured context only for presentation; retain raw native matching and Return metadata.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and opaque/system-colour fallbacks.
donts: Don't apply the dark collection material to every product surface.
Don't substitute pale universal text on light papers or dark universal text on dark papers.
Don't turn a cleaned title into a URL, verified origin or reconstructed folder path.
Don't infer Windows blur, focus, docking or mixed-DPI acceptance from browser screenshots.
